name: Arena Swim Snorkel III
description: The durability is the whole story. The frame and seal shrug off seasons of chlorine, the soft liquid-silicone strap stays comfortable long after cheaper straps stiffen, and the purge valve clears easily.

name: FINIS Long Floating Fins for beginners
description: The exception to the short-blade rule, and the fin nearly every swimmer starts on. The extra length and float give true beginners the propulsion and flotation to learn the kicking motion.

name: Arena Freeflow Pull Buoy
description: A sculpted contour built to sit against the thighs without the death-grip squeeze. If standard peanut buoys have ever felt awkward or chafed, this is the fix — and the more the buoy fits, the more you can relax your lower body, which is…

name: TYR Catalyst swim paddles
description: A power-builder's paddle — clear size options, a contoured shape, and adjustable straps that hold securely for heavy pull sets with a buoy. For experienced swimmers with solid technique who want to load the catch.
